description: PAID $0.03 USDC. Hack / exploit stolen-funds tracker (Binance hack Oct 2026, attributed to North Korea/Lazarus by TRM): every attacker + linked wallet with ETH/USDT/USDC/WETH holdings, frozen status, outbound transfers, Uniswap swaps, bridge/mixer use, exchange-inflow alerts, latest dumps, moved 1h/24h. Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tron; a failed chain is served as stale_last_good with stale {as_of, block, age_seconds}; spread_ok/max_spread_seconds per figure. On-chain, refreshed every 3 min. Returns JSON attacker and linked wallets with holdings, frozen status, swaps, bridge or mixer use, exchange-inflow alerts, and 1h/24h moved amounts.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

incident.description: Incident id. Format: a lowercase slug. The existing description is binance-2026. Example: binance-2026. Omit only if you want the server's current default incident.

limit.description: Maximum wallet rows. Format: positive integer. Example: 50. Omit for the server's current cap.
